Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Bleed

Ghoul (Centipede) deals bleed damage to all enemies he attacks, dealing damage over time and greatly reducing HP regeneration for the duration of the bleed.

This makes him effective against Regen enemies. He's also recommended as a budget bleeder along with Hammergirl. His case is his SPA with no upgrades on is extremely cost-efficient on Shielded enemies.
